name.ja: BB戦士411 黄蓋グフ&合体武装6種(乙)
name.en: BB Senshi 411 Huang Gai Gouf & 6 types of combined weapons (Otsu)

description.ja: • 「歴戦の老将軍」黄蓋グフが装いを新たに再キット化！
description.en: • "The veteran general" Hwang Gai Gouf has been re-kitted with a new look!

description.ja: • 一部にメタリックグロスインジェクションが使用され、高級感のある本体色に変更されている！
description.en: • Metallic gloss injection is used in some parts and the color of the main body has been changed to give it a luxurious feel!

description.ja: • メタリック成形の合体武装6種（乙）が付属し、「典韋アッシマー 賈詡アシュタロン 攻城兵器セット＆合体武装6種（甲）」付属の（甲）と組み合わせることで12合体巨大武装を再現できる！
description.en: • Metallic molded 6 types of combined weapons (Part 2) are included, and by combining them with the ``Dian Wei Assimar Jia Xu Ashtalon Siege Weapon Set & 6 types of combined weapons (Part 1)'' included (Part 1), you can recreate 12 combined huge weapons!

description.ja: • パッケージイラストは新規描き起こし！
description.en: • The package illustration is newly drawn!
